source.publication: Hulusi Karabiber and Yonca Deniz Gurol (2026). Feedback, competition, and cooperation. Acta Psychologica 266, 106908
source.evidence: Primary paper sections 4.2 and Table 2 as indexed by ScienceDirect
source.rights: Use published aggregate counts only; no personal rows, OSF access or individual source retrieval.

A: Does aggregate overall exclusion 13/232 guarantee negligible per-arm retention differences between 6 experimental arms, given only included counts?

B.H1: Exclusions can be unevenly concentrated and leave wide retention imbalance despite low pooled exclusion share.
B.H0: Every feasible nonnegative allocation of 13 exclusions across six arms yields arm retention range <= 13/232.
B.rival: The article's published outcome comparisons concern the explicitly retained >=1-minute sample; this may be a valid conditional estimand without claiming all randomized subjects.

C.estimand: Upper feasible difference in inclusion/retention shares across arms, conditional on excluded registrants having belonged to exactly one of six arms.
C.formula: max_over_allocations [max_j n_j/(n_j+e_j) - min_j n_j/(n_j+e_j)] where sum e_j=13, e_j integer>=0

expected.one_witness: 13 excluded in any arm with 36 included, all other arms 0

C.multiplicity: Single preselected bound; no scan of unreported outcome measures.

E: After freezing this JSON: execute exact matched code and seven standard-library tests; capture stdout, exit, SHA and result.
F: Distinguish feasibility bound from measured attrition imbalance, true treatment effect, bias or p-value. Excluded unassigned group unknown. If any excluded were not assigned to a condition, interpretation is conditional only. No original individual data.
G: Independent comparison of source published count with total and future possible report; no external replication at this stage.
H: Update prior: low overall exclusions do NOT by themselves bound arm-specific selection when their allocation is unknown. No inference to PFL actual effects.
I: Bound as pure arithmetical methodological sensitivity, not novelty scientific 1/3 absent independent test and prior-art review. CT2 stays 22.
J: If native tests pass classify C04 valid limited AB-R published-aggregate reanalysis 0/3; maintain remaining C05 unopened unless genuinely new opportunity.
